description: Internal refurbishment to first floor flat including: new mechanical, heating, electrical, lighting and hot and cold water installations; formation of two bathrooms and a kitchen and new partitions;  formation of door from the 1950s lift core directly into flat; new oak flooring to public areas and bedrooms; formation lowered ceiling in central area over kitchen and second bathroom and formation of plant area over; repairs and conservation to existing plaster cornices and friezes; new matching lengths of cornice and frieze along southern internal wall; repairs and new matching sections to decorative plasterwork within main bedroom; new doors; repairs to existing skirting boards and new matching sections; repairs to existing plaster ceilings; and redecorations.Listed building consent only.
